source.publication: 2025 Schedule M1M Income Additions and Subtractions
source.section: Form M1 lines 1-4, 7-10 (instructions PDF p.13 Standard Deduction Table for Line 4, p.14 Worksheet A, p.39 Tax Rate Schedules, pp.32-38 tax table); Schedule M1M line 12 and Worksheet for line 12 steps 1-30 (M1M PDF p.3, p.4)

worked: One dollar over 84,490: the first 10% step. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages 67,491.00 + taxable Social Security 17,000.00 = 84,491.00. Social Security benefits (Form 1040 line 6a) 20,000.00; line 6b taxable 17,000.00 (federal worksheet: benefits taxable up to 85%; given, not tested). Federal taxable income = 84,491.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction (15,750 plus 0 x 2,000) = 68,741.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form M1, single: line 1 federal AGI 84,491.00. Schedule M1M line 1 other-state municipal interest 0.00; line 10 additions 0.00; Form M1 line 2 0.00; line 3 = 84,491.00. Schedule M1M line 12, Worksheet: step 1 84,491.00; step 2 84,490.00; step 3 1.00; step 4 1.00 / 4,000 rounded up = 1; step 5 0.1; step 6 17,000.00; step 7 1,700.00; step 8 = 15,300.00 (step 29, Tier 1 step 26 is 0.00). Keep share 0.9. Alternative method, projection: measure = federal AGI + tax-exempt interest = 84,491.00 + 0.00 = 84,491.00; cap first: lesser of 17,000.00 and 4,560.00 = 4,560.00; less 20% x (excess over 69,250.00, 15,241.00) = 3,048.20; alternative = 1,511.80. Worksheet steps 9-24 as printed: steps 9-11 84,491.00 - 17,000.00 = 67,491.00; steps 12-13 50% x 20,000.00 = 10,000.00; step 14 0.00; step 15 77,491.00; steps 16-18 0.00; step 19 77,491.00; step 20 69,250.00; step 21 8,241.00; step 22 1,648.20; step 23 4,560.00; step 24 2,911.80; step 25-27 17,000.00; step 28 2,911.80; step 30 greater of 2,911.80 and 15,300.00 = 15,300.00. Line 12 = the better of the two, 15,300.00. The projection's alternative entry loses, so only the simplified amount is applied. Schedule M1M line 16: no one is 65 or older (born before January 2, 1961), so no Schedule M1R subtraction. Schedule M1M line 40 = Form M1 line 7 subtractions = 15,300.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 15,300.00 (lines 12, 16, 17, 25). State income before deduction = 84,491.00 - 15,300.00 = 69,191.00. Standard Deduction Table for Line 4 (PDF p.13): base 14,950.00; AGI is not over 238,950.00, so no Worksheet A. Line 4 = 14,950.00. Form M1 line 8 total = 14,950.00 + 15,300.00 = 30,250.00; line 9 Minnesota taxable income = 84,491.00 - 30,250.00 = 54,241.00. Line 10 tax from the rate schedule (PDF p.39): 5.35% x (32,570.00 - 0.00) = 1,742.495 + 6.80% x (54,241.00 - 32,570.00) = 1,473.628 = 3,216.123. The tax table (PDF pp.32-38) gives 3,217; expected keeps the schedule formula. Line 16 credits 0.00; state income tax 3,216.12.
accepted_approximations: Tax comes from the rate schedules at every income; below 86,800 of taxable income the booklet requires its 100-wide tax table.
